title: Formula Record
description: M4 addition. Structured formula entry produced by Vyasa's notes + tricks lanes when source_unit contains a formula. Maps to canonical §A5 formula_library. Per-formula: LaTeX expression + plain-English statement + applicability conditions + worked example + dimensional consistency + derivation index.

latex_expression.description: LaTeX-formatted formula, e.g. 'v^2 = u^2 + 2as' or 'PV = nRT'. Inline-friendly (no surrounding $...$).

statement.description: Plain-English statement of the formula, e.g. 'Final velocity squared equals initial velocity squared plus twice the product of acceleration and displacement.'

variables.description: Per-variable meaning + SI unit. e.g. [{'symbol': 'v', 'meaning': 'final velocity', 'unit': 'm/s'}, ...]

applicability_conditions.description: Bullet list of when the formula applies (and when it doesn't).

worked_example.description: One concise worked example showing the formula in use.

dimensional_check.description: Dimensional consistency check, e.g. '[LT^-1]^2 = [LT^-1]^2 + [LT^-2][L] = [L^2T^-2]'. Optional but recommended for physics + chem.

derivation_chapter_ref.description: NCERT chapter where this formula is derived, e.g. 'Class 11 Physics, Chapter 3'.

applied_in_chapters.description: List of chapters where this formula is later applied (cross-chapter index).

priority.description: How critical this formula is to know cold.
